placements.title: Onboarding a new hire is a checklist they run through, not a page they read
placements.frame: What does a new hire's first week actually consist of, and what changes when that first week is carried by a checklist rather than by a wiki page?
placements.why: The only existing leaf, Narrative_CalibrationVerifiedAgainstReferencePlates, is about instrument calibration and reference plates and holds nothing here. The content passes the grain test: onboarding a new hire is a standing subject future envelopes will keep feeding (steps, accounts, pairing, shadow shifts, the artifact that carries them), not a one-time measurement. The leaf names the shift the position's member carries — a first-week practice that displaced the old wiki page — rather than restating the checklist items, which stay at position grain.
consulted: Narrative_CalibrationVerifiedAgainstReferencePlates — calibration reference-plate theme; unrelated to onboarding
